personal.preferred_title: Senior Data Engineer | ETL/ELT Pipelines | Cloud Data Platforms | Data Quality

summary: Senior Data Engineer with 20+ years of experience designing and operating scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL-driven data models, and analytics workflows in regulated enterprise environments. Strong hands-on Python and SQL background with proven ownership of transformation logic, data quality validation, and reliable stakeholder-facing delivery. Production cloud experience is centered on AWS (Glue, Athena, S3), with practical upskilling in Snowflake, Databricks, and Azure data-platform foundations.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Architected and maintained automated ETL/ELT pipelines (Python, Pandas, SQL) ingesting telemetry from 6,000+ endpoints into reporting systems used by technical and business stakeholders.
Built and optimized data models for historical retention and trend analytics, improving query performance and enabling executive-level decision support.
Implemented data quality checks (cleansing, QA, anomaly checks) before downstream reporting to improve trust and consistency.
Consolidated data from multiple monitoring systems (BMC TrueSight, CA Wily, AppDynamics) into unified analytical datasets.
Automated recurring reporting workflows and reduced manual operational effort through scripted pipeline improvements.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to prioritize data requirements, improve delivery reliability, and support SLA-aligned reporting.

experience.title: Performance Engineer
bullets: Led data-mining and analysis efforts on user-performance telemetry to identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.
Supported cloud migration activities on AWS and monitoring modernization for business-critical systems.
Produced dashboards and performance metrics for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

experience.title: SME for CA APM (Senior Consultant)
bullets: Led large-scale platform implementations and upgrades, managing high-volume telemetry environments.
Designed custom dashboards, alerts, and extraction scripts to improve data visibility and operational response.
Collaborated with engineering teams to troubleshoot bottlenecks and improve system reliability.

experience.title: Performance Test Engineer
bullets: Analyzed performance bottlenecks in J2EE telecom applications and documented key capacity metrics.
Automated data collection and reporting workflows for load/performance analysis.

experience.title: Senior Systems & Data Migration Engineer
bullets: Led migration from 200+ MySQL nodes to a 6-node Oracle RAC architecture for high-throughput transaction workloads.
Built automated conversion/testing workflows and helped maintain data integrity/performance during migration.
